New York: a Fifth Avenue institution just named new leadership at its biggest milestone.

Lanessa Elrod, the former president and CEO of Louis Vuitton Americas, has been named president of Bergdorf Goodman as the store marks its 125th anniversary this year. She succeeds Tracy Margolies, who moves to executive adviser at Exemplar Luxury Group, formerly known as Saks Global, National Jeweler reports.
